title: Meru County: elections, Parliament and public money
note: Reproduces IEBC's 2022 register by constituency and the Kenya Gazette's declared winners, winners only. Meru: 772,139 registered (702,480 in 2017); its constituencies Igembe South 77,126, Igembe Central 93,434, Igembe North 77,050, Tigania West 70,283 (64,114 in 2017), Tigania East 83,527, North Imenti 96,241, Buuri 82,341, Central Imenti 76,495 and South Imenti 115,642, which add up to the county's and are each its wards as IEBC's register by polling station adds them up. Woman rep: Kailemia Elizabeth Karambu, UDA, 259,445 (Gazette 9951); MCAs: Gazette 9956 (Athwana, Dionisio Jim Muchui, UDA, 3,864). Read 19 October and 19 November 2026.

title: ATHWANA Ward: MCA and Election Results
note: A third-party site carrying IEBC's declared results, every candidate as printed (surname first). 2017: 6,177 valid votes, which the six candidates add up to. 2022 lists the winner only (Dionisio Jim Muchui, UDA, 3,864, as the Gazette gives), so it isn't entered. 2013 gives no parties, so it isn't entered either. Read 19 October 2026.

title: MERU County: Constituencies, Wards and Results
note: A third-party site carrying IEBC's declared results for the county's seats. Woman rep 2017: all six candidates as printed (surname first), 539,446 valid votes, which they add up to. Woman rep 2022: the four leading of the eleven candidates IEBC listed, the winner's 259,445 as Gazette 9951 gives; its 478,113 is those four added up, not the valid votes, so no valid total is entered. Governor 2022: all three candidates, 503,821 valid; 2017: all six, 541,574 valid. The 2022 names and parties are IEBC's candidate list (electionskenya.org's copy of it), names as other names then surname; that list has Beth Kanana for ODM where this page says Jubilee. None is given by constituency. 2013 gives no parties, so it isn't entered. Its register (627,210) is older than IEBC's 2022 one, so it isn't entered. Read 19 November 2026.
